documents.title: Policy on Responsible Use of Artificial Intelligence at TSU (Policy No. 1.09)
documents.date_or_term: effective upon approval (board committee item April 28, 2025)
documents.summary: Board-approved university-wide policy on responsible AI use by students, faculty and staff. Students may use AI where faculty allow and must cite it; AI completing assignments is prohibited unless faculty permit it. It also sets data-privacy limits, a prohibited-use list, enforcement through existing codes, oversight offices and training.
documents.stance_why: The policy does not set one rule for all courses: 'Faculty may elect to allow students to use AI for particular assignments' and instructors 'have the authority and responsibility to set course-specific AI policies', though it also sets a fallback that AI use to complete assignments 'is strictly prohibited unless allowed by course faculty'. The decision is handed to instructors, so delegates.
